_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Government Furnished Inspection Equipment Maintenance Report
summary: The Government Furnished Inspection Equipment Maintenance Report provides data on Government furnished inspection equipment (GFIE) maintenance activities of the contractor and his field personnel.
description_purpose: 3.1 The Government Furnished Inspection Equipment Maintenance Report provides data on Government furnished inspection equipment (GFIE) maintenance activities of the contractor and his field personnel.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.

7.2 This DID is used to report contractor maintenance actions to keep GFIE in satisfactory condition.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Contract.
preparation_instructions.content: This data item is generated by the contract which contains a specific and discrete work task to develop this data product.

preparation_instructions.title: Content and format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Government Furnished Inspection Equipment Maintenance Report shall be in contractor's format and contain the following:

children.title: Name and serial number of GFIE repaired or adjusted.
Engineering evaluation of cause of malfunction or part failure.
Corrective action(s) required to correct malfunction.
Parts replaced (if any) to correct the malfunction.
children.content: Reference part to manual (if possible); otherwise, describe part for proper identification.
